title: Kit Viewer Loads Real Kit Data From Host Context
description: Fix McpKitViewer showing 0 designs/types/ports: only apply kit payload when non-empty shell; merge deepFindKitToolArguments from host context with ontoolinput; wire ontoolinputpartial and onhostcontextchanged; extend refetch delays; rebuild mcp-app.
summary: McpKitViewer no longer treats stripped kit shells as loaded data: applyKitPayload only runs when isKitViewerPayloadSufficient (non-empty kitArtifacts per isEmptyKitArtifactsData). Refetch uses mergeKitToolArguments (deepFindKitToolArguments on host context plus ontoolinput/ontoolinputpartial). Added ontoolinputpartial merge, onhostcontextchanged refetch, longer delayed refetch schedule, and host-context effect only applies sufficient payloads. Vitest: deepFindKitToolArguments and isKitViewerPayloadSufficient. Rebuilt compose/engine dist/mcp-app.html.
